name: __init_tasker_session
description: First call of any Tasker session: preferences plus the directive playbook

name: add_milestone
description: Add a milestone to a task. The milestone text is passed as text (the original app's argument name); summary is accepted as an alias for it, and is the name this backend uses for the same field in responses and in update_milestone.

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

summary.description: Alias of text, kept because it is this backend's own field name. text wins if both are sent.

name: build_new_flow
description: The interview playbook for building a new flow (task selection, I/O wiring, naming) grounded against a real project. Read-only -- this creates nothing; name_flow does the actual creating.

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project.

name: clear_task_output
description: Clear a task's output contract (its definition-of-done rules) -- the delete counterpart of set_task_output. The human blessing goes with it. Nothing else on the task is touched.

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31) -- the PRODUCER.

name: complete_milestone
description: Mark a milestone complete

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

milestone_id.description: Milestone UUID or id. Preferred over index — stable under reordering.

index.description: Zero-based position within the task's milestones. Supported for compatibility; racy if milestones are being reordered concurrently.

name: complete_task
description: Mark a task complete

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: confirm_contract
description: Human-bless a task's OUTPUT contract. Agent-authored contracts are AI-QA'd (QA is performed by AI, not a meat sack) until a human has reviewed and approved the quality bar. Confirmation is non-destructive, but ANY subsequent set_task_output, clear_task_output, set_task_input or remove_task_input touching this task resets it to AI-QA'd.

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31) whose output contract a human has approved.

name: create_environment
description: Create an Environment (organizational unit) — alias of core's OU create

name: create_group
description: Create a group within a section

section_id.description: Section UUID, id, or slug (slug requires project_id).

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Needed only when section_id is a slug. Omit to use your default project.

name: create_ping
description: Create a connectivity ping in the caller's tenant

name: create_project
description: Create a project (with its default Backlog section)

prefix.description: Optional 2-5 uppercase letters for short ids (e.g. TDE). Derived from the name when omitted.

environment_id.description: Optional Environment (OU) to create the project in.

context.description: The project Foundation: goal, why, scope, definition_of_done and related keys.

name: create_section
description: Create a section within a project

project_id.description: Project prefix, slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project.

name: create_task
description: Create a task

project_id.description: Project prefix, slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project.

section_id.description: Optional. Defaults to the project's Backlog section.

detail.description: Context. Write so a cold reader with no chat history can act on this task alone.

name: delete_environment
description: Delete an Environment (organizational unit) — alias of core's OU delete

name: delete_flow
description: Delete a flow. Its member tasks are NOT deleted -- they return to the board (flow_id cleared) and keep every I/O edge they already had.

flow_id.description: Flow UUID, id, or short ID (e.g. TDE-F1).

name: delete_group
description: Delete a group (its tasks are un-grouped, not deleted)

section_id.description: Needed only when group_id is a slug.

name: delete_milestone
description: Delete a milestone

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

milestone_id.description: Milestone UUID or id. Preferred over index — stable under reordering.

index.description: Zero-based position within the task's milestones. Supported for compatibility; racy if milestones are being reordered concurrently.

name: delete_project
description: Permanently delete a project and all its sections, tasks, and milestones. Always confirm with the user before calling this.

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id.

confirmed.description: Must be true to confirm permanent deletion

name: delete_section
description: Delete a section. By default REFUSES if the section still has tasks (move them to another section first, e.g. via update_task/move_task_to_group). Pass delete_tasks: true to delete the section together with all its tasks and groups. Irreversible — confirm with the user before calling.

project_id.description: Needed only when section_id is a slug.

delete_tasks.description: If true, delete the section AND every task/group in it. If false (default), the section must already be empty or the call is refused.

name: delete_task
description: Delete a task. If the task is a flow step, the flow's remaining steps keep the right relative order but their numbering is left with a gap (1-2-3 becomes 1-3) -- call recompute_flow_steps to close it.

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: derive_output_contract
description: Derive a PRODUCER task's output contract (definition-of-done) from what its CONSUMERS already demand of it -- the input-edge rules of every task wired to consume its output. Author the consumers' inputs first, then derive, rather than hand-authoring the producer's bar twice. Returns the draft plus the ASSUMPTIONS the merge rests on: SURFACE those to the human. Read-only unless apply is true.

task_id.description: The PRODUCER task whose output contract to derive (UUID or short ID, e.g. TDE-31).

apply.description: If true, persist the derived draft as this task's output contract (resetting the human blessing, exactly as set_task_output does). Default false -- return the draft + assumptions only, for human review.

name: get_board
description: Get a project's full board: sections, groups, tasks, milestones

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project.

name: get_flow_context
description: Get a flow's shared context bag (plus its full record: name, members' step order is on get_flow_order, step_list_open, etc.)

flow_id.description: Flow UUID, id, or short ID (e.g. TDE-F1).

name: get_flow_order
description: A flow's members in the order they must run (topological, recomputed on every I/O edge change). Address it either by flow_id, or by task_id to get the order of whichever flow that task belongs to. One of the two is required -- there is no default flow.

flow_id.description: Flow UUID, id, or short ID (e.g. TDE-F1). Takes precedence when task_id is also supplied.

task_id.description: Any task in the flow (UUID or short ID, e.g. TDE-31) -- the flow is found from it. Use instead of flow_id.

name: get_my_attention
description: The "what needs me?" triage for the CALLING USER'S OWN non-done work -- not the whole team's. Matched by created_by (tasker_tasks has no assignee column). Two buckets in the response: overdue (due_date before today) and stale (in_progress and not updated in 2+ days -- fixed, not configurable). Within EACH bucket, CRITICAL (pinned) tasks are listed first, ahead of the bucket's own normal order. NOT AVAILABLE ON THIS BACKEND (the original also covers these, but this schema has no such concept yet): tasks awaiting review verdict, pending human guidance, and agent sessions awaiting input. A task qualifying for both available buckets appears in each, not deduplicated. A completed (done) task appears in no bucket. project_id is optional, and omitting it means every project in your OU scope -- NOT your default project, unlike every other tool in this plugin.

project_id.description: Project prefix, slug, UUID or id. Omit to search across every project in your OU scope (this does NOT fall back to your default project).

name: get_project
description: Get a single project: its sections and every task, regardless of status

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project.

include_notes.description: Include each task's detail field. Defaults to false — on a large project this can be very large.

name: get_ready_work
description: List a project's non-done tasks, ranked by what to work on next

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project.

name: get_task
description: Get a single task, including its milestones and its output contract (the definition-of-done rules, and whether a human has blessed them)

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: get_task_connections
description: Both directions of a task's I/O wiring: BLOCKERS (the producers whose output it consumes) and DEPENDENTS (the consumers that consume its output), each with that edge's own expected_type and quality contract.

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31).

name: get_task_discussion
description: Read a task's AI discussion and focus reason

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: list_environments
description: List the tenant's Environments (organizational units) — alias of core's OU list

name: list_flows
description: List flows. project_id is optional: it falls back to your default project, and if you have none set, every flow across your whole OU scope is returned.

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Omit for your default project, or every project in scope if you have none set.

name: list_groups
description: List a section's groups

section_id.description: Section UUID, id, or slug (slug requires project_id).

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Needed only when section_id is a slug. Omit to use your default project.

name: list_milestones
description: List a task's milestones

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: list_pings
description: List the tenant's connectivity pings

name: list_projects
description: List the caller's OU-scoped projects

environment_id.description: Optional: only projects in this Environment (OU), by integer id. Omit to see every Environment.

name: list_sections
description: List a project's sections

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project.

name: list_tasks
description: List tasks, filtered by project, section, group or status

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project.

status.description: Defaults to excluding done tasks. Pass "all" to include everything.

name: move_task
description: Move a task to a DIFFERENT project

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31) to move

target_project_id.description: Destination project: prefix (e.g. WCP), slug, or UUID

target_section_id.description: Optional: a section UUID in the TARGET project to drop the task into. If omitted (or not in the target project) the task lands in the target project's own Backlog section (this backend's substitute for "no section" -- tasker_tasks.section_id cannot be null) -- never an error.

name: move_task_to_group
description: Move a task into a group, un-group it, or reorder it

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

group_id.description: Group UUID, id, or slug to set. Pass null explicitly to UN-GROUP the task. OMITTING this key entirely leaves its group membership UNCHANGED -- this is what makes a sort_order-only reorder call safe: it never touches group_id at all. The ONE exception: if section_id moves the task to a different section, an omitted group_id CLEARS the group, because a group belongs to one section and the task no longer sits in it.

section_id.description: Optional. Also moves the task into this section, and is the section group_id is validated against. Defaults to the task's current section. Moving to a DIFFERENT section clears the task's group unless you supply a group_id in the same call that belongs to the new section.

sort_order.description: ADDITIVE: explicit board ordering within the task's section. The live original exposes NO reordering tool over MCP at all (its drag-and-drop is a web-UI concern served over its own REST layer) -- D2's own drag-and-drop frontend needs this here. Optional: omitting the key, or passing it as null, both leave sort_order unchanged (this is what lets a pure reorder call, e.g. {task_id, sort_order}, leave group_id alone too -- see group_id's own description). Any other value must be an integer or the call 400s.

name: name_flow
description: Create a flow: name it, stamp membership on its tasks, and compute their initial topological order from the I/O edges already wired between them. There is no separate create tool -- this call both creates the flow and assigns its members.

project_id.description: Project prefix, slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project.

name.description: Human name for the flow (e.g. "Blog Post Publication Flow").

task_ids.description: Every task in the flow (UUIDs or short IDs, e.g. TDE-31). All must already belong to the project.

context.description: Optional shared context for the flow -- background, goals, constraints, or instructions that apply to all tasks in it. Must be a JSON OBJECT (not a string or array) -- see parity-allowlist.php for why this differs from the original.

step_list_open.description: True when the flow's full step list is not yet known (research/investigation -- it discovers steps as it goes). Default false.

name: pin_task
description: Pin a task

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: rank_tasks
description: Return non-done tasks ranked by priority then due date -- "what should I work on next?". D1 dropped skip_count, so unlike the original app this cannot rank by skip-decay. If project_id is omitted, your default project is used when you have one set; otherwise pass confirmed: true to rank across EVERY project in your scope.

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project (falls through to confirmed if you have none).

confirmed.description: Only needed when project_id is omitted AND you have no default project set. Pass true to rank tasks across ALL projects in your scope.

name: recompute_flow_steps
description: Repair hatch: re-derive a flow's step order from its tasks' I/O edges and re-stamp it. Rarely needed for ORDER -- set_task_input and remove_task_input already re-stamp it in the same transaction as the edge write. DO run it after delete_task removes a flow member: the remaining steps keep the right relative order, but their numbering is left with a gap (1-2-3 becomes 1-3) and recomputing closes it.

flow_id.description: Flow UUID, id, or short ID (e.g. TDE-F1). Always required -- there is no default flow to fall back to.

name: remove_task_input
description: Remove the I/O edge feeding task_id (the CONSUMER) from source_task_id (the PRODUCER), and re-stamp the owning flow's step order in the same transaction. source_task_id is REQUIRED here -- see parity-allowlist.php for why this differs from the original's "omit to remove every input edge" form.

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31) -- the CONSUMER.

source_task_id.description: The upstream source whose edge to remove.

name: rename_environment
description: Rename or reparent an Environment (organizational unit) — alias of core's OU update

parent_id.description: New parent Environment id, or null to move to root.

name: rename_group
description: Rename a group (alias of update_group, preserved for existing agents)

group_id.description: Group UUID, id, or slug (slug requires section_id).

section_id.description: Needed only when group_id is a slug.

name: rename_section
description: Rename a section (alias of update_section, preserved for existing agents)

section_id.description: Section UUID, id, or slug (slug requires project_id).

project_id.description: Needed only when section_id is a slug.

name: set_default_project
description: Set or clear the caller's default project

project_id.description: Project UUID, prefix, slug or id. Null clears the default.

name: set_task_discussion
description: Save a task's AI discussion and focus reason

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: set_task_input
description: Wire an I/O edge: task_id (the CONSUMER) receives source_task_id's (the PRODUCER) output as input. Upserts on the (source_task_id, task_id) pair, and re-stamps the owning flow's step order in the same transaction. Refused if it would close a dependency cycle.

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31) -- the CONSUMER.

source_task_id.description: Upstream task whose output this task consumes (the PRODUCER for this edge).

contract.description: A quality contract for this input. Must be a JSON OBJECT (not a string or array).

expected_type.description: Optional coarse type hint for this input.

replace.description: If true, replace ALL of task_id's other inbound edges with just this one. Default false (upsert only this source's edge).

name: set_task_output
description: This task's OUTPUT CONTRACT -- the PRODUCER's single definition-of-done for the one artifact it produces. Consumers are DERIVED (any task wired to it with set_task_input), so this takes no target. Replaces any existing contract, and RESETS the human blessing: the new rules are AI-QA'd until confirm_contract.

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31) -- the PRODUCER.

contract.description: A quality contract: an ordered list of rules the artifact must satisfy, e.g. {"rules": [{"label": "Cites enough sources", "rule": "at least 3 primary sources", "kind": "check"}]}. Context-free / portable -- describe the SHAPE of acceptable output, never this run's subject. Must be a NON-EMPTY JSON object.

name: tag_ping
description: Attach an existing tag to a ping

name: tag_task
description: Attach an existing tag to a task

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: uncomplete_milestone
description: Restore a completed milestone to incomplete

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

milestone_id.description: Milestone UUID or id. Preferred over index — stable under reordering.

index.description: Zero-based position within the task's milestones. Supported for compatibility; racy if milestones are being reordered concurrently.

name: uncomplete_task
description: Restore a completed task to pending

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: unpin_task
description: Unpin a task

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

name: update_flow_context
description: Merge or replace a flow's shared context, and/or flip step_list_open

flow_id.description: Flow UUID, id, or short ID (e.g. TDE-F1). Always required -- there is no default flow to fall back to.

context.description: The keys to write. Must be a JSON OBJECT (not a string or array) -- see parity-allowlist.php for why this differs from the original. Merged into the existing context by default (a shallow merge). Omit entirely to leave the context untouched (e.g. when you only want to flip step_list_open). Pass replace: true to discard the existing context wholesale instead.

replace.description: When true, context replaces the whole document instead of merging into it. Defaults to false (merge). Ignored (treated as a no-op on context) when context itself is omitted.

step_list_open.description: True = the full step list is not yet known (research/investigation discovering its next step as it goes). Set false once the extent is known -- changeable either way mid-run. Omit to leave unchanged.

name: update_group
description: Update a group's name or sort order

group_id.description: Group UUID, id, or slug (slug requires section_id).

section_id.description: Needed only when group_id is a slug.

name: update_milestone
description: Update a milestone's summary, detail, or sort_order

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

milestone_id.description: Milestone UUID or id. Preferred over index — stable under reordering.

index.description: Zero-based position within the task's milestones. Supported for compatibility; racy if milestones are being reordered concurrently.

name: update_project
description: Update a project's name, environment, prefix or sort order

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id.

prefix.description: 2-5 uppercase letters, or null to clear.

environment_id.description: Move the project to this Environment (OU).

name: update_project_context
description: Merge or replace a project's Foundation context

project_id.description: Project prefix (e.g. TDE), slug, UUID or id. Omit to use your default project — but REQUIRED when replace is true, since a destructive replace is never applied to a project you did not name.

context.description: The keys to write — goal, why, scope, definition_of_done and related Foundation keys. Merged into the existing context by default (a shallow merge: a nested object you supply replaces the corresponding nested object wholesale, it does not deep-merge inner keys). Pass replace: true to discard the existing context entirely instead.

replace.description: When true, context replaces the whole document instead of merging into it. Defaults to false (merge) — the original tool is used to add Foundation keys incrementally.

name: update_section
description: Update a section's name, description, sort order or view preferences

section_id.description: Section UUID, id, or slug (slug requires project_id).

project_id.description: Needed only when section_id is a slug.

name: update_task
description: Update a task's text, detail, priority, due_date, or status

task_id.description: Task UUID or short ID (e.g. TDE-31)

due_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or null to clear.

status.description: Setting this to done stamps completed_at; setting it to pending or in_progress clears completed_at -- same as complete_task/uncomplete_task.
